description: Lets your OrgHQ association site send newsletters and member email from your own domain: adds the DKIM signing key and the SPF and MX return-path records for the sending domain.
variableDescription: dkimkey: the DKIM public key issued for this sending domain (base64, without the p= prefix); region: the sending region named in the return-path MX host, e.g. us-east-1
